--- pipe_join_conditionless.sql
FROM LeftTable
|> JOIN RightTable

--- AST
&ast.QueryStatement{
  Query: &ast.Query{
    Query: &ast.FromQuery{
      From: &ast.From{
        Source: &ast.TableName{
          Table: &ast.Ident{
            NamePos: 5,
            NameEnd: 14,
            Name:    "LeftTable",
          },
        },
      },
    },
    PipeOperators: []ast.PipeOperator{
      &ast.PipeJoin{
        Pipe:  15,
        Op:    "INNER JOIN",
        Right: &ast.TableName{
          Table: &ast.Ident{
            NamePos: 23,
            NameEnd: 33,
            Name:    "RightTable",
          },
        },
      },
    },
  },
}

--- SQL
FROM LeftTable |> INNER JOIN RightTable
